contexts.dma: M retirement within the same-epoch accepted DMA active interval
contexts.dual: M retirement while DMA and chiplet AES are both active
contexts.sleep: M retirement during DMA active and actual chiplet SLEEP followed by RUN
contexts.pressure: M request starts with four unread completions and DMA active; M retires before drain

additional_scenario: Enabled device IRQ arrives during M; M retires before handler entry with mepc equal to next PC
limitations: One operand construction per bin; not exhaustive reset, configuration-reference, or timing closure
